sources.entry: Gimp - Gimp is GNU Image Manipulation Program.

summary.one_liner: GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program) is a free, open-source image editor; this README is for the unstable 3.3 development branch.
summary.what_it_does: The README is mostly a project orientation page rather than a feature list. It points to the GIMP home page, a documentation site, and a source code location, and links to contributor resources such as developer environment setup, coding style, and first-patch guides. It lists discussion options including IRC channels on GIMPNet and forums. It explains that the GTK interface can be customized through GTK config files, a per-app gimp.css file, and a shortcutsrc file for keybindings. It also states a project policy that no generative-AI content is allowed in GIMP-managed repositories. Specific image-editing features are not described in this text.
use_cases: contribute to open-source image editor development
how_to_run: See the file INSTALL in the repository for detailed installation instructions.
Read devel-docs/README.md if you want to build or hack on GIMP.
stack: GTK (implied by GTK config and theme references)
notable: Official GIMP project repository for the 3.3 development branch
Interface customizable via GTK settings, gimp.css, and shortcutsrc files
Project policy bans generative-AI content in its repositories
Contributor onboarding docs referenced in devel-docs/README.md
caveats: This is an unstable development release, not a stable GIMP version.
Installation details are in the separate INSTALL file, not in this README.
